types.title: Value match
types.description: Show when one selected output contains your text, ignoring capitalization.

types.title: Artifact current
types.description: Show when the selected output is current.

types.title: Artifact stale
types.description: Show when an existing output is stale relative to selected earlier outputs.

types.title: Markdown files
types.description: Count Markdown files beside a selected output for each workflow.

types.title: Checklist progress
types.description: Count checked and total items in a current Markdown checklist.

types.title: Checklist complete
types.description: Show when every checkbox in a current, nonempty Markdown checklist is checked.

types.title: Phase run complete
types.description: Show when the selected phase's latest run completed.

types.title: Phase artifact complete
types.description: Show when the selected output and chosen earlier outputs are current. Among matching phase artifact badges, only the furthest phase appears at each location; summary counts remain cumulative.
